checks.name: guard reader supplements actual foundation with NOLOGIN, no membership and SELECT-only RLS
actual SET ROLE reads all nine metadata tables and pg control facts without RLS bypass
metadata writes and escalation are denied by actual ACLs, not only a default read-only setting
one-shot metadata rerun and wrong target database do not alter authority
inherited PUBLIC column UPDATE prevents metadata reader installation atomically
PUBLIC database TEMP is refused without changing the database ACL
consent reader refuses an old schema without adopting its missing issuer
inherited PUBLIC definer function and column write each prevent consent reader installation
consent reader reads only approved columns and cannot mutate or read other account data

qualification: Actual isolated PostgreSQL ACL/RLS policy checks with restricted disposable LOGIN wrappers; not production credential activation, TLS, owner common or nonempty receipt readback.
